key: experiment name- name of experiment
notes: median fluorescence units were used for experiments

key: filtration_method- were samples filtered through an anotop or with the TFF
day- date of sampling
hour- hours into experiment
sample- sample id number
strain_id- strain number or species id (see g_oceanica, t_lutea, i_galbana, p_globosa)
treatment- describes what cells were treated with
liths- were coccoliths added to experiment
cell count- raw cell number, derives from flow cytometry
lith background- background events in gate drawn to quantify coccoliths, derives from flow cytometry
lith count- raw coccolith number, derives from flow cytometry
vesicle count- raw extracellular vesicle number, derives from flow cytometry
vesicle count expanded- raw extracellular vesicle number with expanded 100-200 nm gating, derives from flow cytometry
virus count- raw virus number, derives from flow cytometry
bacterial count- raw bacteria number, derives from flow cytometry
volume- sampling volume from flow cytometer (uL)
cell concentration- cell concentration (cell per mL)
lith concentration- coccolith concentration (coccoliths per mL)
flow_rate_ul_30s- flow rate from influx used for vesicle, virus, and bacterial quantification
vesicle concentration- extracellular vesicle concentration (vesicles per mL)
vesical concentration expanded- vesicle concentration from expanded 100-200 nm gating (vesicles per mL)
virus concentration- virus concentration (virus per mL)
bacterial concentration- concentration of bacteria (bacteria per mL)
lith cell ratio- ration of free coccoliths to cells
vesicle cell ratio- ratio of extracellular vesicles to cells
naked- percentage of naked cells
calcified- percentrage of calcified cells
background fluorescence- background fluroescence units at 520 nm
background dead- the background percentage of dead cells unstained control
sytox- percentage of dead cells minus background
ros- H2DCFDA fluorescence units at 520 nm
normalized ros- H2DCFDA fluorescence units minus background
background_per_lyso_mito- background percentage in lysotracker and mitotracker positive gate
lyso- percentage of lysotracker positive cells
mito- percentage of mitotracker positive cells
background_flu_lyso_mito- unstained background fluorescence units at 640 nm on flow cytometer
lyso_flu- lysotracker fluorescence units at 640 nm
mito_flu- mitotracker fluorescence units at 640 nm
high_mito- percentage of cells with healthy mitochondria
caspace_perc_pos- percentage of caspase positive cells
flisp_perc_pos- percentage of flisp positive cells
flisp_rfu- flisp fluorescence units at 520 nm
caspace_rfu- caspase fluorescence units at 520 nm
percent_bodipy- percentage of bodipy positive cells
